rules.title: Bazelisk and .bazelversion
rules.text: Use Bazelisk and pin the Bazel version in .bazelversion so everyone builds with the same release.

rules.title: Targets before everything
rules.text: Run specific targets, for example bazel test //pkg:target, before running the whole workspace.

rules.title: Restrict visibility
rules.text: Restrict target visibility to the packages that need it.

rules.title: Declare every dependency
rules.text: Declare every dependency in BUILD files. Do not rely on transitive dependencies.

rules.title: Named configs
rules.text: Group flags into named configs in .bazelrc and select them with --config.

rules.title: Hermetic toolchains
rules.text: Pin toolchains and runtimes, for example a remote JDK, instead of using whatever is installed locally.

rules.title: Format with buildifier
rules.text: Format BUILD and .bzl files with buildifier.

rules.title: Never edit bazel-* links
rules.text: Never edit files through the bazel-* output symlinks.
